package.description: Local Windows hotkey tool for marking stream highlights and exporting editor-ready timestamps.

en-US.description: Local Windows hotkey tool for marking stream highlights and exporting editor-ready timestamps.
en-US.longDescription: MarkMyVOD Lite is a free local Windows tool for marking important moments while recording or streaming. It supports a global Ctrl+Shift+M hotkey, notes, editable timestamps, local session save and restore, CSV export, and YouTube chapter export. It requires no account and contains no advertising or telemetry.
en-US.name: MarkMyVOD Lite
